sources.description: Original user-provided wordlist, first examples and translations, preserved as an exact backup.

New contextual explanations, corrected readings and translations, second examples and usage notes authored for this project on 2026-10-04. Per-entry references are in the CSV 来源说明 field and curated source files.

referencePolicy: HanDian, MOE dictionaries and other cited references were used to verify facts. No third-party example corpus or dictionary pages are redistributed; new examples are independently authored.
separation: Lexicon content derived from CC-CEDICT retains CC BY-SA 4.0. Stroke geometry retains the separate Arphic Public License. Independent app source code is not relicensed by these data notices.
